text: Mateo's driving test is May 14. Third attempt. He's trying to act chill about it but he was chewing his nails the whole time we talked.
thabo got made redundant fri. whole team gone. says hes fine but he didnt sound fine
Kiri and Dong celebrating ten years married on June 3rd, renting a cabin up north for the weekend.
Need to text Reggie good luck before his audition sometime next week, he wouldn't say which day.
Vanessa's grandad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is end of the month, probably the 28th. She was really close to him, he basically raised her for a few years when her mum was working away.
Xavier proposed!! Darius said yes on the beach in Lisbon, ring is apparently enormous
pick up dry cleaning, post office before 5, ring the garage about the MOT
Ethan results day is August 13th. Wants medicine at Leeds, needs AAA. His dad is more nervous than he is honestly.
Oliver and Lola have split up. Six years. She's moved back in with her parents for now. Don't mention it at Anya's thing.

Long chat with Niamh at the school gate. Her theory test is 7/1, she's done the hazard perception practice about fifty times and still panics on it. Her husband's been taking her out in his car on Sundays but they mostly end up arguing. Remind me to ring her on 7/2 to see how it went.

So, voice note. Just got off the phone with Ignacio. His mum, Svetlana, she had the scan results back and it's all clear, which is a huge relief. He's also sitting his bar exam early March and he's been studying like twelve hours a day. Oh and his cat Pimiento is apparently hating the new flat.
Eva's engaged to Freya's cousin Jorge, wedding sometime over the summer next year, they haven't picked a date yet
Keisha failed her driving test again yesterday. Clipped a kerb on the reversing bit. She's gutted. Rebooked for October 30.
alina's wedding is off. they called it off last week. she's ok-ish, more relieved than anything apparently
Ben passed his grade 8 piano! distinction!!

Antoine got told on Tuesday his role is being cut. Consultation meeting 11/4, last day probably end of November. Two kids and the mortgage, he's really worried. His wife's only part time at the library so it's a lot. He's already updating his CV and has a call with a recruiter sometime next week. I should check in with him after the meeting.
Connor mentioned his anniversary with Sophie is coming up, Nov 9. He wants to do something but has zero ideas. She's been eyeing that pottery class thing, could suggest that.
Anders - Lars's husband - just finished his PhD viva, passed with minor corrections. Party at theirs Saturday.
Zara's dad died. Thursday night, heart attack. Funeral not set yet. Send flowers to her and her mum.

ok so Sean, Saanvi's boy, has his audition for the junior ballet programme on April 22nd. Saanvi's taking him down on the train the night before. He's 11 and absolutely terrified, she said he's been practising in the kitchen every evening. If he gets in it's every Saturday in London which is a big commitment for them. Results should come mid May. Send him a good luck card.
Nikolai said his sister Svetlana is getting married in Kraków in early June, he's best man and is dreading the speech
Mrs Kaur from next door lost her husband. Must take something round this week, maybe a lasagne

Lunch w Mateo. His girlfriend Kiri's sitting her nursing finals end of the month, he says she's barely sleeping. They're also talking about getting engaged once she's qualified but she doesn't know he's already looking at rings. Mentioned she wears a lot of rose gold.
Thabo + Dong are flying out to Johannesburg sometime next week for Thabo's uncle's funeral. Back around the 20th
note to self: book my own driving test, they're releasing slots for January soon
Reggie really into bouldering now, goes 4x a week. Vegetarian since summer too
Vanessa's brother Darius is doing his citizenship test May 2nd. Don't forget to ask her how it went.
Xavier and Darius' engagement party is Saturday June 7 at the Albion, 7pm. I'm doing the playlist.
Ethan's girlfriend dumped him over text. Day before his mocks. Poor kid. He's staying at his gran's for a bit.

Talked with Oliver at the wake. He's holding up, says the hardest bit is clearing out his dad's workshop. Asked if I could help sometime over the summer. I said yes. Need to sort a weekend with him in the next couple weeks.
Lola - nickname Lolly apparently, only her nan calls her Lola - got the part!! Lead in the spring musical, opens 3/19
Anya's parents' 40th wedding anniversary is Sept 12th. She's organising a surprise lunch. I should chip in for the gift, she said maybe a framed print of their old house.
Niamh doing her ACCA exams in early December, then a holiday after. Says she's fine but she's had three migraines this month.
Ignacio Bianchi (Nacho) left a voicemail, his band got into the battle of the bands final, it's on the 15th
Svetlana's son Nikolai passed his driving test this morning, first go. She sounded so proud. Text him congrats.
Eva got the redundancy letter on Monday. Weirdly she's quite excited, wants to retrain as a teacher, already looking at PGCE courses starting in September.
Freya's dog Biscuit had to be put down on Friday. She's in pieces. Maybe drop round a card.
Jorge and Keisha's wedding — Saturday, August 23rd. RSVP by end of the month! Plus one allowed. They're registered at John Lewis.
Alina had her grade 5 theory exam this morning. Remind me to ask her how she found it.
Ben's mum passed last spring, the anniversary is coming up early April. He goes quiet around then. Worth checking in that week.
Antoine's a structural engineer at Arup. Lives in Walthamstow with his partner and their two kids.
Connor's stag do is in Prague, Sept 18th to 21st. Sean's organising. I said I'm in.

Dinner with Anders and Lars last night. Lovely evening, they've done the kitchen up beautifully. Lars is coeliac so remember that for next time. Their daughter Zara has her GCSE results on 8/21 and she's convinced she's failed maths. Anders also mentioned his company is restructuring and there's talk of layoffs sometime in the new year. He's trying not to think about it. Ask Lars how Zara's results went.
Saanvi and her husband Dr Usman just found out they're expecting! Due in late April. Telling family at the weekend.
call nikolai re: the deposit for the hall
Sophie Nowak's dissertation viva is on December 4th, she's really anxious. Uncle Reggie is driving up to support her.
Mateo's grandma Lola turns 90 on March 3rd. Big family do.
Thabo said Kiri's band is splitting up. Last gig 6/28 at the Fleece. Might go.

Feeling a bit flat after the call with Dong. He and his fiancée broke off the engagement two weeks ago, so obviously the wedding in September isn't happening now. He's been off work since, signed off for stress until the end of the month. His sister Alina is staying with him for a bit which is good. He's still running every morning, says it's the only thing keeping him sane. Don't push, just keep messaging every few days.
Gym, then food shop, then meal prep. Stop buying crisps.
Darius is learning Portuguese for the wedding, which is sweet. He's had Duolingo going 200 days straight.
Text Vanessa on the 28th, that's the funeral. And again the week after.

Xavier's mum, Mrs Olsen, retires from the hospital end of June after 35 years on the children's ward. Party for her is July 2nd at the cricket club, partners welcome. He wants us all to sign a card and maybe put towards a weekend away for her and his dad, they haven't had a proper holiday since their honeymoon. Remind me to get a card before then.
Ethan's older brother Oliver got into Juilliard!! Starting in the fall. Whole family flying out with him in late August.

Lola's mum's cancer is back. She has a scan in the next fortnight and then they'll decide on treatment, probably early December. Lola's trying to keep it together for her little brother Ethan who's in his A level year. She said the worst bit is not knowing. Check in with her Friday and maybe offer to drive them to the hospital.
Anya mentioned she failed her first-year exams, has resits in mid-August. She's embarrassed, hasn't told her parents. Keep it quiet.
Niamh and Ignacio are renewing their vows on their 25th, June 21st. Asked me to do a reading.
Quick catch-up with Svetlana on the bus. Not much news.

Eva says Freya's dad got made redundant from the steelworks after 30 years, he's taking it hard. Freya's going home sometime next week to be with him. Her mum's worried he'll just sit in front of the telly. Freya was thinking of getting him into the allotment, he's always loved growing tomatoes. Also Freya herself has her nursing exams on May 20th so the timing's awful.
Jorge's driving theory is booked for 5/9, his practical not until after the summer. He wants a cheap first car, something like an old Fiesta. Might be worth asking my brother about his.
